title: LLM4Trust: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Trust Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.33521v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trust evaluation plays a critical role in cybersecurity by supporting risk mitigation and decision-making. A variety of trust evaluation methods have been proposed, with learning-based approaches offering high accuracy and automation. However, they often require substantial ground truth, suffer from low training efficiency, lack support for basic trust properties, and provide limited explainability. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a compelling alternative due to their strong zero-/few-shot reasoning abilities and broad knowledge. To this end, we propose LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores the capabilities of LLMs for trust evaluation. We first construct diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and design corresponding property understanding tasks. translated_title: LLM4Trust：探索大语言模型在信任评估中的能力
translated_abstract: 信任评估通过支持风险缓解和决策制定，在网络安全中发挥着关键作用。目前已提出多种信任评估方法，其中基于学习的方法具有高准确性和自动化的优势。然而，这些方法通常需要大量的真实标注数据，训练效率低下，缺乏对基本信任属性的支持，且可解释性有限。大语言模型（LLM）凭借其强大的零样本/少样本推理能力和广泛的知识储备，提供了一种极具吸引力的替代方案。为此，我们提出了LLM4Trust，这是首个系统探索大语言模型信任评估能力的基准框架。我们首先构建了多样化的信任图来建模五种基本信任属性，并设计了相应的属性理解任务。随后，我们评估了八个代表性大语言模型在九种提示方法下理解这些属性的能力。基于这一探索…
tldr: 本文提出首个系统性基准框架LLM4Trust，通过构建信任图建模五种基本信任属性，并在九种提示方法下评估八个代表性大语言模型的属性理解能力，系统探索了LLM在信任评估中的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores LLM capabilities for trust evaluation by constructing diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and assessing eight representative LLMs' property understanding abilities under nine prompting methods.
